thread:
jordan: Quick async check — I'm prepping an AWQ rollout for mpt-30b variant (smaller KV cache profile). Weights are staged at s3://redwood-models/mpt30b/releases/v2/awq-128/weights.bin. Planning to push to staging tomorrow 09:00 PT.

jordan: Two asks: (1) tokenizer sanity check — some prompts in eval set show weird tokenization around em-dashes and nonbreaking spaces; (2) sign-off on AWQ vs GPTQ for staging given accuracy/latency tradeoffs.

jordan: Config I'm using for the run:
```yaml
model: mpt-30b
quant: awq-128
fp8: false
calib_dataset: s3://redwood-calib/mpt30b/v2/calib-10k.jsonl
batch_size: 8
seed: 42
max_seq: 1024
```

taylor: looking. can you paste the tokenizer sample that failed?

jordan: sure — sample: "We met at 10—11am in room 4B7; agenda: scope, risks." tokenized as: ["We", "met", "at", "10", "—11", "am", "in", "room", "4\u00B7", ";", "agenda", ":", "scope", ",", "risks", "."] — expected split at em-dash.

samira: that looks like the tokenizer's punctuation rule is merging em-dash with numbers. might be the byte-pair vocab not containing EM_DASH separately. which tokenizer artifact are you using?

jordan: using `tokenizers/mpt-tokenizer-v1` from artifacts (s3://redwood-artifacts/tokenizers/mpt/v1). Hash: abc123def.

mike: I can run a quick tokenization diff against the gold. ping me the eval subset and I'll run locally.

jordan: sending 200-sample eval slice to s3://redwood-calib/mpt30b/v2/slices/tokenizer-check-200.jsonl — grant: eng-ml-team.

infra-bot: CI build 3178 for `release/awq-mpt30b` passed (unit + smoke). Docker image: ghcr.io/redwood/serving:awq-v2-3178.

samira: saw the eval numbers from yesterday: AWQ-int8 vs FP16 baseline — exact-match drop ~0.9% on our internal QA prompts, Rouge-L delta -0.6. Latency p50 improved ~18ms, cost per token estimated -22%.

taylor: GPTQ-int4 gave better compression but had a larger accuracy delta on long-form QA (~2.3% drop), plus more tail latency variance.

jordan: thanks. main question: is AWQ-int8 acceptable for staging (we prefer it for lower regression), and should we block prod until tokenizer fix is confirmed?

ops: for staging OK on AWQ-int8. but blocker for prod: need tokenizer mismatch fixed or a documented regression window and fallback to FP16 for routes with strict QA. Also request a canary with 5% traffic and automatic fallback if eval regression >1.5% on canary prompts.

mike: tokenizer diff looks like a single rule tweak. patch incoming in PR #4512 (small Vocab update + normalization). Will run recalib after merge.

taylor: +1 for AWQ to staging once PR is merged and tokenizer slice passes. Can we add a short eval harness run: 20k tokens across our top-50 prompts? estimate ~30m run-time on dedicated CI GPU.

samira: agree. also flag fp8: we haven't validated FP8 under burst loads; don't enable in staging yet.

jordan: noted — will disable fp8 and schedule the 20k-token harness after PR merge. I'll kickoff staging deploy 09:00 PT tomorrow with 0% prod traffic.

taylor: ping me in-thread when the PR merges; I'll review the harness output. :thumbsup:

mike: PR merged + pushed artifacts. calib rerun queued.

infra-bot: Calib job 882 queued on gpu-pool-small (ETA ~22m).

jordan: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for the harness results — will update with canary config and final sign-off.

ops: noted. when you post canary config include rollback window and metric thresholds (we'll codify in rollout policy).

samira: quick note for release notes: include accuracy deltas and the tokenizer fix summary so support teams can triage tickets.

jordan: will do. thx all.
